fixed: "Ring balance, spin to the right", as Caller's Companion writes it, now comes in as a petronella with its balance instead of text, and a bare "Ring balance" as balance the ring. This applies to imports and to figures you type. A line that adds another clause after a comma ("…, face new Neighbors") still comes in as text for now.

changed: The shared figure recognizer reads "ring balance" as balance_the_ring, and a ring balance followed by a spin to the right as petronella with balance: true.
In free-text entry and the re-parse upgrade, a note that only names the figure's own move ("(petronella)" on a petronella) no longer demotes the reading.
